title: AIR Specification-First Verification Executor v2
description: Bounded non-agent Executor layer for mechanical or explicitly review-classified Specification-First Verification operations authorized by the bound Orbit 0 AIR_ARTIFACT and governed by the SFV Method Pack.

authority_boundary.operative_use_rule: Execute only bounded verification operations permitted by the bound Orbit 0 AIR_ARTIFACT, ACTIVE artifact lease, matching resource scope pin when material, current approval, current method step, current evidence/tool permissions, and AIR_GATE. Material effect attempts require a single-use AIR_ACTION_AUTHORIZATION and post-effect Core RT.RECEIPT / AIR_ACTION_RECEIPT before dependent continuation.

allowed_operations: construct traceability mappings from canonical acceptance criteria to verification items
classify verification items by verification layer
check for canonical criteria with no verification path
check for verification items with no canonical target
compare observed results with predeclared expectations
identify stale or invalidated verification evidence from supplied state
compile deterministic fixtures or test definitions when the active method selects executable testing
run authorized bounded checks with available permitted tools when the active contract explicitly allows tool execution
localize failed verification items to affected specification targets
produce intent-reconciliation and closure-readiness candidates without approving closure
prohibited_operations: creating or changing canonical intent or acceptance criteria without authorized rescope
treating planned verification as observed evidence
claiming a check ran when no tool, source, operator, or reviewer evidence exists
claiming production readiness, compliance, safety, or truth from narrow verification results
using external tools, systems, credentials, or mutation authority without explicit current authorization
transferring prior-task SFV authorization, verification specification, or evidence into a newly bound task without applicability revalidation
independently selecting or binding MII cognitive routes
treating SFV contribution candidates as AIR_GATE, RT.ACTION, RT.RECEIPT, RT.DELIVER or RT.CLOSE authority
reducing required verification evidence because standard evidence presentation is selected
execution_preconditions: exactly one bound Orbit 0 AIR_ARTIFACT authorizes the operation
the controlling artifact lease is ACTIVE for the current task, step, action class, source and environment state
a matching resource_scope_pin covers the exact tool, file, repository, system, environment, permission class and action target when material

current SFV method step and method_step_gate are known or the operation is an explicitly allowed proportionate inline verification check that preserves all material verification and evidence obligations
required source, tool, environment, evaluator, permission and approval states are satisfied or explicitly unresolved
expected output and failure route are defined
current Orbit 0 AIR_ARTIFACT task identity matches the SFV state being consumed; prior-task SFV state has been revalidated for applicability after any NEW_TASK_BOUNDARY

integration_refresh.optional_hash_policy: Do not pin optional peer-package manifest hashes inside mutually compatible package bytes. Validate exact manifest identity, hash, version, dependencies and task fit at selection time to avoid cyclic hash invalidation.

mii_sfv_contribution_contract.fusion_boundary: SFV may identify evidence support/conflict edges, verification gaps and intent-reconciliation candidates, but Core MII owns cognitive contribution fusion and the AIR_ARTIFACT benchmark owns operative consumption.
mii_sfv_contribution_contract.authority_boundary: No SFV cognitive contribution, verification result, adequacy recommendation or specialist decision independently authorizes execution, material action, delivery, closure, approval, binding or Orbit 0 occupancy.

semantic_fidelity_contract.sfv_rule: SFV derives verification targets from resolved canonical intent, active context, acceptance criteria and authoritative source state. Verification shaping may not silently replace, narrow, broaden or reinterpret material intent.
semantic_fidelity_contract.closure_rule: Passing selected verification is insufficient for closure unless the verified result reconciles back to canonical intent, active context and current acceptance criteria through Core delivery/closure routes.
semantic_fidelity_contract.raw_input_boundary: A verification specification, translated requirement or intent-reconciliation candidate never supersedes raw user input as evidence of what the user actually said.

epistemic_sufficiency_contract.sfv_role: Identify missing specification basis, authoritative evidence, environment state, evaluator evidence or user-controlled ambiguity and propose the smallest sufficient missing input.
epistemic_sufficiency_contract.non_inference_rule: Material uncertainty is not converted into an operative assumption merely to complete a verification path.
epistemic_sufficiency_contract.continuation_rule: Continue only where the unresolved uncertainty is non-material to the affected verification target or is explicitly gated without weakening acceptance criteria.

morphology_contribution_contract.observable_effect_requirement: Every morphology recommendation must state the verification objective and observable effect on decomposition, coverage, pruning or review. Labels without observable effect are UNBOUND_DECORATIVE.
morphology_contribution_contract.claim_boundary: SFV may not claim direct latent-space control, measured internal model effect, or BACKEND_BOUND morphology without evidence.

test_evidence_contract.presentation_only_rule: The -t modifier controls evidence presentation and packaging only. It does not reduce evidence acquisition requirements, preservation, verification coverage, cognitive work, benchmark rigor, review obligations, acceptance criteria or closure requirements.
test_evidence_contract.standard_presentation_rule: Show the verification decision, scoped counts or states, evidence classes, material failures, limitations and sufficient evidence references without omitting evidence needed to justify the result.
test_evidence_contract.expanded_presentation_rule: Surface available reviewable test/evaluation artifacts and references when they exist and may be disclosed.
test_evidence_contract.retroactivity_rule: Presentation mode may reveal already preserved evidence but must not fabricate missing historical evidence. A new authorized run is required when evidence itself is missing for an applicable acceptance, regulatory or reproducibility obligation.
test_evidence_contract.rights_and_reasoning_boundary: Do not expose hidden reasoning, private chain of thought, secrets, credentials, restricted source text or unavailable backend logs.

core_route_ownership.sfv_effect: SFV supplies candidate verification strategy, cognitive/evidence contributions, adequacy findings, observed verification results and closure recommendations. It does not create parallel Core routes or positive execution authority.

alignment_evaluation_dependency.relationship: Any formal AIR object that incorporates SFV output must satisfy the current Core evaluation-basis constructor dependency. SFV candidate records are not a bypass.

mii_contribution_authority.operative_rule: SFV Domain, Method, Specialist and Executor outputs become operative only after validation and compilation into or explicit reference by the sole bound Orbit 0 AIR_ARTIFACT.execution_benchmark_profile.

capability_ecology_peer.note: Observed T7 candidate identity is validation evidence for T9 only; runtime selection validates the then-supplied exact package.

grounding_peer.note: Observed T8 candidate identity is validation evidence for T9 only; runtime selection validates the then-supplied exact package.

trigger_language: run one authorized bounded SFV check
use_when: A single bounded traceability, verification-layer, adequacy, evidence-classification, result-comparison, staleness, or failure-localization operation is required.
The operation is authorized by the active AIR_ARTIFACT and fits the current SFV Method step or an explicitly permitted proportionate inline verification check.
do_not_use_when: The work requires a reusable multi-step verification procedure or persistent method_execution_state.
Canonical intent, acceptance criteria, source/tool/evaluator/permission state, or required approval is materially unresolved.
The request would redefine canonical intent, certify readiness/compliance/safety/truth, or grant closure/material-effect authority.
required_inputs: exactly one bound Orbit 0 AIR_ARTIFACT authorizes the operation
the controlling artifact lease is ACTIVE for the current task, step, action class, source and environment state
a matching resource_scope_pin covers the exact tool, file, repository, system, environment, permission class and action target when material

current SFV method step and method_step_gate are known or the operation is an explicitly allowed proportionate inline verification check that preserves all material verification and evidence obligations
required source, tool, environment, evaluator, permission and approval states are satisfied or explicitly unresolved
expected output and failure route are defined
current Orbit 0 AIR_ARTIFACT task identity matches the SFV state being consumed; prior-task SFV state has been revalidated for applicability after any NEW_TASK_BOUNDARY
allowed_sources: sources explicitly available and permitted by the active AIR_ARTIFACT, current source-rights state, and applicable package/source contracts
forbidden_sources: sources outside current task scope or source-rights state
restricted, paid, private, credentialed, or otherwise unavailable source material without current authorization
allowed_tools: tools explicitly permitted by the active AIR_ARTIFACT, artifact lease, resource_scope_pin, and current approval state when material
forbidden_tools: tools outside the active artifact lease/resource_scope_pin
material-effect tools without Core RT.ACTION preconditions, AIR_GATE ALLOW, single-use authorization, and receipt requirements
procedure: Validate the active AIR_ARTIFACT, task identity, current acceptance criteria, SFV Method context, and source/tool/evaluator/approval state.
Select exactly one package-local allowed_operations variant under the canonical operation.
Verify the expected result/evidence class and required failure route before execution.
Execute only the selected bounded verification variant with the currently permitted tools/sources.
Emit the contained verification result candidate, evidence classification, failures/limitations, intent-reconciliation candidate, and next-gate recommendation.
review_checkpoints: before execution: criterion/trace target, expected result, evidence class, source/tool/evaluator authority
after execution: observed-vs-planned evidence, coverage/adequacy, failure localization, intent reconciliation, and claim boundary
handoff_conditions: verification is incomplete at session boundary
observed evidence or unresolved verification gaps are required by a later SFV Method step
staleness, environment, source, acceptance-criteria, or task-boundary state must survive continuation
escalate_to_method_when: multiple verification operations require coordinated sequencing
method_execution_state, evidence-to-advance gates, staleness review, or portable verification state becomes material
escalate_to_specialist_when: verification adequacy requires task-specific benchmark judgment beyond a bounded operation
material specialization or reusable verification constraints are missing
claim_boundary: Produces bounded verification result and evidence candidates only. Passing a selected check does not establish production readiness, compliance, safety, truth, canonical-intent satisfaction, approval, closure, or material execution authority beyond the evidence actually observed.
